text: 港股午间收盘，恒生指数跌2.64%，恒生科技指数跌2.45%。科指成分股中，MINIMAX跌6%，天数智芯跌超5%，智谱、哔哩哔哩、理想汽车、小米、快手等均跌超4%。
text_en: Hong Kong stocks closed the morning session with the Hang Seng Index down 2.64% and the Hang Seng Tech Index down 2.45%. Among Hang Seng Tech constituent stocks, MINIMAX fell 6%, Iluvatar CoreX fell more than 5%, and Zhipu, Bilibili, Li Auto, Xiaomi, Kuaishou and others all fell more than 4%.
